authority: Phase 13 user instruction: permitted development material only; reserved cohort remains sealed through all 18 phases and parser freeze.

roles.TUNING: Rule development and model fitting on permitted material. Scores are development diagnostics.
roles.EXPOSED_DIAGNOSTIC: Existing inspected validation examples, including the original 15 courses. May inform rules; cannot prove untouched generalization.
roles.FRESH_VALIDATION: Existing reserved cohort. No inspection, source use, scoring or review-answer access until all 18 phases complete and parser frozen.
roles.TEST: Separate protected release evaluation. Unopened and excluded from phase work; release use requires its own protocol and authorization.

historical_artifacts_and_partition_regis: Preserved; diagnostic overlays do not rewrite old scores or assignments.
grouping_policy: Take the transitive union of all known dependency links. A connected family cannot cross evaluation roles. Keep all catalog years of an institution together for institution-transfer claims.
template_similarity_limit: Stable identities do not establish template independence. Unknown cross-institution catalog-family links require permitted source review before any template-transfer claim.
future_freeze_contract: All 18 phases completed with reviewable evidence; a version label alone is insufficient.
Pin parser code, rules/configuration, model/tokenizer versions, dependencies, sampling/split manifests, metric definitions and scoring code.
Freeze predictions independently of answers and use unique central-page course starts for denominators.
Predeclare strict core completion, field diagnostics, false proposals, ownership/contamination, unresolved sources, abstentions and cost.
Report per-institution results and family-level uncertainty; overlapping windows and repeated catalog years are not independent observations.
After outcomes influence a change, mark the cohort exposed and require another untouched cohort for renewed confirmation.
